cover.title: How Robinhood Makes Money With $0 Trades
cover.label: $0 FEES

lines.text: Robinhood charges zero commissions. So how did it make $4.5 billion last year?
lines.say: Robinhood charges zero commissions. So how did it make four and a half billion dollars last year?

lines.text: More than half came from trading: $2.6 billion.
lines.say: More than half came from trading. Two point six billion dollars.

lines.text: When you trade stocks or options, big trading firms pay Robinhood to handle your orders. It's called payment for order flow.
lines.say: When you trade stocks or options, big trading firms pay Robinhood to handle your orders. It's called payment for order flow.

lines.text: Options alone brought in $1.1 billion. Crypto trading added $901 million.
lines.say: Options alone brought in one point one billion dollars. Crypto trading added nine hundred and one million.

lines.text: Then there's interest: on customers' cash and on margin loans. That's another $1.5 billion.
lines.say: Then there's interest, on customers' cash and on margin loans. That's another one and a half billion.

lines.text: Plus Robinhood Gold, a paid subscription with 4.2 million members.
lines.say: Plus Robinhood Gold, a paid subscription with four point two million members.

lines.text: So the trade is free to you. But your trades, and your cash, still make money for someone.

post.title: How Robinhood makes money with $0 trades
post.ig:
Robinhood charges $0 commissions. It still made $4.5B in 2025.

$2.6B came from trading: trading firms pay to handle customers' orders (payment for order flow). Options: $1.1B. Crypto: $901M.
$1.46B came from interest on customer cash and margin loans.
Plus 4.2M paid Gold subscribers.

Source: Robinhood full-year 2025 results (Feb 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
